translations.text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, writes to the twelve tribes scattered abroad: Greetings!
So you have made distinctions among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts.
But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who oppress you? Is it not they who drag you into courts?
For judgment is without mercy for anyone who has not shown mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
You see that a person will be made righteous through deeds, and not through faith alone.
Look also at the ships: although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by small rudders in whatever direction the pilot wants.
There is one lawgiver and judge, who has the power to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
